title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
description: Shakespeare's Puck (Mickey Rooney) and forest fairies prompt a triple mortal wedding, with entertainment by Bottom (James Cagney).

title: Dames
description: A chorus girl (Joan Blondell), producer (Dick Powell) and dancer (Ruby Keeler) put on a Broadway show. Choreographed by Busby Berkeley.

title: Gold Diggers of 1933
description: A songwriter's (Dick Powell) big check puts chorus girls (Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler) to work but incurs his brother's wrath.

title: 42nd Street
description: A Broadway producer (Warner Baxter) sends in the understudy (Ruby Keeler) when his show's star (Bebe Daniels) twists her ankle.

title: Footlight Parade
description: A director (James Cagney) creates and stages extravagant musical prologues for movie theaters.

title: Arsenic and Old Lace
description: A theater critic (Cary Grant) learns his two elderly aunts serve poisoned elderberry wine to lonely gentlemen callers.

title: State of the Union
description: An heiress (Angela Lansbury) wants a self-made man (Spencer Tracy) to run for president with his estranged wife (Katharine Hepburn) by his side.

title: Ladies of Leisure
description: Wealthy artist Jerry Strong asks a striking call-girl to pose for him, but their budding relationship is complicated by his friend and his interfering parents.

title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
description: A folksy New England poet (Gary Cooper) inherits $20 million he doesn't want and tells a New York newswoman (Jean Arthur) why.

title: Small Town Girl
description: A New England miss (Janet Gaynor) meets a rich stranger (Robert Taylor) who's surprised the next morning to hear they got married.

title: The Strawberry Blonde
description: An ex-convict dentist (James Cagney) recalls his wife (Olivia de Havilland) and another man's wife (Rita Hayworth), in circa-1900 New York.

title: Flower Drum Song
description: Residents (Nancy Kwan, James Shigeta, Miyoshi Umeki) of San Francisco's Chinatown mix East with West in custom and culture, ending with a double wedding.

title: Camelot
description: King Arthur (Richard Harris) loses Guinevere (Vanessa Redgrave) to trusted Sir Lancelot (Franco Nero) in the colorful court of Camelot.

title: An American in Paris
description: An American soldier (Gene Kelly) stays in Paris after World War II to paint and falls in love with a French beauty (Leslie Caron).

title: Top Hat
description: A woman (Ginger Rogers) believes that an enamored dancer (Fred Astaire) is her best friend's husband.

title: West Side Story
description: Against a backdrop of vicious gang warfare between the New Yorker Jets and the Puerto Rican Sharks, a romance develops across rival lines. 1960s update of "Romeo and Juliet", with amazing song and dance sequences.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Absence of Malice
description: A federal bureaucrat (Bob Balaban) leads a Miami newswoman (Sally Field) to libel a dead gangster's honest son (Paul Newman).

title: Smokey and the Bandit
description: Sheriff Buford T. Justice (Jackie Gleason) chases a trucker, his buddy (Burt Reynolds), a runaway bride (Sally Field) and 400 cases of beer.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: Murphy's Romance
description: A divorced mother (Sally Field) moves to an Arizona ranch and meets a widowed pharmacist (James Garner) twice her age.

title: Doughboys
description: A privileged and affluent young man mistakenly enlists in the military, hoping to win the heart of a beautiful USO performer.

title: Speak Easily
description: Thanks to his butler (Jimmy Durante), a professor (Buster Keaton) thinks he has inherited a fortune and lives it up.

title: The Passionate Plumber
description: A woman of Paris (Irene Purcell) poses a plumber (Buster Keaton) as her lover to make her boyfriend jealous.

title: Free and Easy
description: Midwesterner Elmer (Buster Keaton) takes a beauty-contest winner (Anita Page) and her mother (Trixie Friganza) to Hollywood.

title: Pick a Star
description: A small town Iowa girl heads to Hollywood with dreams of stardom and becomes a big star owing to a publicity agent.

title: Burn 'Em Up O'Connor
description: A farm boy (Dennis O'Keefe) goes from midget cars to the big time, proving someone has been drugging his boss's (Harry Carey) drivers.

title: Death on the Diamond
description: A rookie pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals investigates the mysterious murders of several of his teammates.

title: Murder in the Fleet
description: A Navy officer (Robert Taylor), his girlfriend (Jean Parker), crew and visitors must stay aboard until the intrigue ends.

title: Air Raid Wardens
description: Rejected by the military, a pair of bumblers volunteer their questionable services to an unsuspecting home front.

title: A Southern Yankee
description: The Union army sends an eager-beaver bellhop (Red Skelton) south to spy, by posing as a Confederate spy.

title: American Masters
description:
S30 E01 — Mike Nichols
The life and 50-year career of director Mike Nichols, one of only two people who have won Peabody, Emmy, Grammy, Oscar and Tony awards.

title: The Graduate
description: An aimless college man (Dustin Hoffman) lets an older woman (Anne Bancroft) seduce him, then finds himself falling for her daughter (Katharine Ross).

title: Biloxi Blues
description: During World War II, a Brooklyn writer contends with a drill sergeant and other situations at a Mississippi boot camp.

title: Working Girl
description: A spunky Wall Street secretary (Melanie Griffith) takes her boss's (Sigourney Weaver) place with a merger specialist (Harrison Ford).

title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
description: A professor (Richard Burton) and his wife (Elizabeth Taylor) drink and verbally assault each other in front of a younger couple, their dinner guests.

title: Gilda Live
description: Comedian Gilda Radner does her Broadway show of "Saturday Night Live" characters, with Don Novello as Father Guido Sarducci.

title: The Great Gildersleeve
description: A spinster tries to force Throckmorton P. Gildersleeve into marriage.

title: Gildersleeve's Bad Day
description: The great Gildersleeve finds himself up to his neck in gangsters after he's appointed jury foreman at a mobster's trial.

title: The Lost City
description:
S01 E03 — Dagger Rock
An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

title: Three Men in White
description: Dr. Gillespie gives two interns cases to solve to decide who will be his assistant.

title: Hare Conditioned
description: A department store manager tries to have Bugs stuffed for the taxidermy department.

title: Looney Tunes
description:
Hare Do
Elmer Fudd uses an army surplus rabbit detector.

title: Tom Thumb
description: A forest queen rewards a woodcutter and his wife with a son (Russ Tamblyn) just shy of six inches high.

title: Roughshod
description: An escaped convict tracks two brothers (Robert Sterling, Claude Jarman Jr.) herding horses and four stranded dance-hall hostesses.

title: The V.I.P.s
description: Very important people (Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, Louis Jourdan) must wait in a London airport.

title: The Last of Sheila
description: A Hollywood producer (James Coburn) shares his Riviera yacht with six people who might have killed his wife.

title: Born Free
description: The British Adamsons raise Elsa the lioness as a pet in Kenya, then teach her how to be wild again.

title: A Hard Day's Night
description: John, Paul, George and Ringo (The Beatles) spend 36 wild hours in London, besieged by exuberant fans.
